verses.en: Sha'ul, a servant of YAHUAH, and an apostle of Yahushua the Messiah, according to the faith of YAHUAH's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;
verses.am: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect, and the acknowledging of the truth which is after godliness;

verses.en: In hope of eternal life, which YAHUAH, that cannot lie, promised before the world began;
verses.am: In hope of eternal life, which God, that cannot lie, promised before the world began; {In: or, For}

verses.en: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of YAHUAH our Saviour;
verses.am: But hath in due times manifested his word through preaching, which is committed unto me according to the commandment of God our Saviour;

verses.en: To Titus, mine own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from YAHUAH the Father and the Master Yahushua the Messiah our Saviour.
verses.am: To Titus, {mine} own son after the common faith: Grace, mercy, {and} peace, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.

verses.en: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee:
verses.am: For this cause left I thee in Crete, that thou shouldest set in order the things that are wanting, and ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed thee: {wanting: or, left undone}

verses.en: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
verses.am: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

verses.en: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of YAHUAH; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;
verses.am: For a bishop must be blameless, as the steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given to wine, no striker, not given to filthy lucre;

verses.en: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
verses.am: But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate; {men: or, things}

verses.en: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers.
verses.am: Holding fast the faithful word as he hath been taught, that he may be able by sound doctrine both to exhort and to convince the gainsayers. {as...: or, in teaching}

verses.en: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:
verses.am: For there are many unruly and vain talkers and deceivers, specially they of the circumcision:

verses.en: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.
verses.am: Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for filthy lucre's sake.

verses.en: One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians are alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
verses.am: One of themselves, {even} a prophet of their own, said, The Cretians {are} alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.

verses.en: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;
verses.am: This witness is true. Wherefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith;

verses.en: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.
verses.am: Not giving heed to Jewish fables, and commandments of men, that turn from the truth.

verses.en: Unto the pure all things are pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.
verses.am: Unto the pure all things {are} pure: but unto them that are defiled and unbelieving {is} nothing pure; but even their mind and conscience is defiled.

verses.en: They profess that they know YAHUAH; but in works they deny him, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate.
verses.am: They profess that they know God; but in works they deny {him}, being abominable, and disobedient, and unto every good work reprobate. {reprobate: or, void of judgment}

verses.en: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:
verses.am: But speak thou the things which become sound doctrine:

verses.en: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
verses.am: That the aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience. {sober: or, vigilant}

verses.en: The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;
verses.am: The aged women likewise, that {they be} in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things; {holiness: or, holy women} {false...: or, one who foments strife}

verses.en: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children,
verses.am: That they may teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children, {sober: or, wise}

verses.en: To be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of YAHUAH be not blasphemed.
verses.am: {To be} discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed.

verses.en: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded.
verses.am: Young men likewise exhort to be sober minded. {sober...: or, discreet}

verses.en: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
verses.am: In all things shewing thyself a pattern of good works: in doctrine {shewing} uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,

verses.en: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.
verses.am: Sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of you.

verses.en: Exhort servants to be obedient unto their own masters, and to please them well in all things; not answering again;
verses.am: {Exhort} servants to be obedient unto their own masters, {and} to please {them} well in all {things}; not answering again; {answering...: or, gainsaying}

verses.en: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of YAHUAH our Saviour in all things.
verses.am: Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

verses.en: For the grace of YAHUAH that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men,
verses.am: For the grace of God that bringeth salvation hath appeared to all men, {hath...: or, to all men, hath appeared}

verses.en: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;
verses.am: Teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly, in this present world;

verses.en: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great YAHUAH and our Saviour Yahushua the Messiah;
verses.am: Looking for that blessed hope, and the glorious appearing of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ; {glorious...: Gr. the appearance of the glory of the great God, and of our Saviour Jesus Christ}

verses.en: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
verses.am: Who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.

verses.en: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
verses.am: These things speak, and exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no man despise thee.

verses.en: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,
verses.am: Put them in mind to be subject to principalities and powers, to obey magistrates, to be ready to every good work,

verses.en: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.
verses.am: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, {but} gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

verses.en: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.
verses.am: For we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving divers lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, {and} hating one another.

verses.en: But after that the kindness and love of YAHUAH our Saviour toward man appeared,
verses.am: But after that the kindness and love of God our Saviour toward man appeared, {love: or, pity}

verses.en: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Set-apart Spirit;
verses.am: Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost;

verses.en: Which he shed on us abundantly through Yahushua the Messiah our Saviour;
verses.am: Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour; {abundantly: Gr. richly}

verses.en: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.
verses.am: That being justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

verses.en: This is a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in YAHUAH might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.
verses.am: {This is} a faithful saying, and these things I will that thou affirm constantly, that they which have believed in God might be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable unto men.

verses.en: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.
verses.am: But avoid foolish questions, and genealogies, and contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

verses.en: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;
verses.am: A man that is an heretick after the first and second admonition reject;

verses.en: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.
verses.am: Knowing that he that is such is subverted, and sinneth, being condemned of himself.

verses.en: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.
verses.am: When I shall send Artemas unto thee, or Tychicus, be diligent to come unto me to Nicopolis: for I have determined there to winter.

verses.en: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
verses.am: Bring Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.

verses.en: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful.
verses.am: And let ours also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they be not unfruitful. {maintain...: or, profess honest trades}

verses.en: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen. «»
verses.am: All that are with me salute thee. Greet them that love us in the faith. Grace {be} with you all. Amen. «{It was written to Titus, ordained the first bishop of the church of the Cretians, from Nicopolis of Macedonia.}»
